investigated_batching.reason: Tasks have dependency ordering; batching would serialize critical path

investigated_batching.notes: Design-note generation already runs concurrently across M1+HP workers - this is effectively batching at the worker level
Only 3-6 embedding calls per run, each <1s. Not on critical path.
Parallel RAG queries (OPT-5) reduced RAG wall from 0.97s to 0.38s. This is batching at the query level.
Each code generation task produces a distinct artifact; batching would require post-processing to split. Current concurrent approach is better.
Validation must run after generation completes
Maven -T 1C uses parallel compilation internally. Build already batched at the compiler level.

conclusion: Batching is only beneficial for RAG queries (already implemented as OPT-5). Other batching approaches would serialize the critical path or add complexity without end-to-end gain.
